content: Delivered: Replaced all 5 bcf_unpack FFI call sites (Record::new, Record::unpack, Record::alleles, Reader::read, IndexedReader::read) with pure Rust bcf_unpack_rs function. Implemented BCF binary decoding helpers (bcf_dec_size, bcf_dec_int1, bcf_dec_typed_int1) as safe Rust functions. Main function handles all 4 unpack phases: STR (ID+alleles), FLT (filters), INFO, FMT. Handles missing-value convention (count=0 → '.') matching C behavior exactly. 8 differential tests compare Rust output against C oracle including real BCF file data. All 217 tests + 38 doc tests pass, clippy clean.
